interface.longDescription: Chop it plans a week of dinners and does the food admin. Say what you fancy, or what's in the fridge, and get dinner ideas in the chat. Try 100 recipes before connecting, or explore more than 1,000 tested UK recipes with a Chop it account. Swap any you don't fancy, then say “use these”: with a Chop it account that's your week, in ChatGPT and on your phone. Shop it once, sorted by aisle with a link to each item at your supermarket. Ask to open Chop it and the app's own screens appear in the chat: This Week, your saved weeks, the Recipe Library, each recipe's method and ingredients, and your pantry. The Weekly Diversity Score keeps variety, fibre and plants on the plate without giving up a Tuesday-night comfort dinner. Plan less, cook more, shop once.
defaultPrompt: Chop it, plan five dinners for four: two chicken, one fish, one vegetarian, one beef.
Chop it, find me a quick chicken dinner.
Chop it, I have chickpeas, spinach and rice. What can I make tonight?
